reason: A pure client-side DSH plugin that provides a global settings toggle to hide or restore tool-call and thinking blocks while leaving user messages and assistant replies visible.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 对话中通过设置开关统一隐藏或恢复工具调用卡片和思考内容，以获得更简洁的对话视图。
summaries.en: Adds a settings toggle to globally hide or restore tool-call cards and thinking blocks in DSH conversations for a cleaner view.

capabilities: Modifies conversation display by hiding and restoring tool-call and thinking blocks
Adds a settings toggle for display control
Persists the toggle state in localStorage
Applies visual styling to process blocks
